name: membraince
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code: recalls what matters when a session starts and with each prompt, and saves what you tell Claude across sessions.

api_key.title: MemBraince API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://membraince.com/portal (starts with mb_live_).

user_id.title: Memory owner
user_id.description: Whose memories these are, inside your account. Use a different value to keep separate memories for different people or agents.

auto_recall.title: Recall automatically
auto_recall.description: Add relevant memories when a session starts and with each prompt. Each prompt makes one search request.

auto_save.title: Save automatically
auto_save.description: Before compaction and when a session ends, save the messages you typed in that session (not Claude's replies or tool output). Each save is billed per your plan.

project.title: Project
project.description: Optional. A project name from the portal to save to and recall from. Leave empty to save to the key's home project and recall from every project linked to the key.
